source: guide/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md (HuggingFace MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 docs/, fetched 2026-10-03); style blocks from guide/skill_handdrawn.md

alignment.i2va: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
alignment.fl2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot {last_shot}) aligns with the {seconds:.2f}-second mark of the target video.
alignment.l2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot {last_shot}]) aligns with the {seconds:.2f}-second mark of the target video.

fields.name: overall_soundscape
fields.empty: Quiet room tone with a faint movement of air.

anchor.i2va: {subject} begins exactly as shown in <Picture 1>, preserving its composition, colours, {surface} and every figure's position: {scene}.
anchor.fl2va: {subject} begins in the composition, colours and {surface} established by Picture 1: {scene}.

landing.fl2va: Toward the end of the shot the movement slows and settles into the composition, {surface} and framing established by Picture 2.

verbs.arc: The camera moves in an arc shot
verbs.follow: The camera follows in a tracking shot
verbs.static: The camera holds a static shot
verbs.hold: The camera holds a static shot

negatives.why: Released FL2VA/Ref2VA checkpoints are CFG-distilled; BasicGuider carries positive conditioning only.
negatives.phrasing: One to three concrete 'No ...' sentences, observable on screen, placed at the end of the shot description.

rules.why: guide 2.1: the instruction must be the first line, followed by one blank line
fl2va splices one <Picture i> block per keyframe; the text must name the same pictures
guide 4.1: state the overall style at the beginning of [Shot 1]
oceanus 2026-10-03: nouns in the style/hold lines were painted as content (men in an empty shot, a cut to hands, interiors sent out to sea)
colour words on skin are painted literally (blue lips, blue-grey eyes, oceanus s026/s033)
looking toward an opening is read as a cue to cut to the view (oceanus s023)
